deviations: Allowed path gap: PH-339 lists pmo_plugins/insights/migrations/0001_initial.py but not migrations/__init__.py. Django 5.2 treats a migrations directory without __init__.py as an unmigrated namespace package, so the plugin SDK rejects the worktree with migration.models_without_migrations. Per instruction the file was not created in the deliverable; validation ran in /tmp/ph339-verify with that single uncommitted file added.

Reconciliation cases are derived from PH-354 precheck issues with a stable logical key of period|domain|owner + rule_code; evidence changes supersede the prior draft/pending row. approved rows are never overwritten by refresh; missing issues are not turned into cases. Active cases whose issue disappears are not auto-closed or auto-resolved; they are listed in stale_case_keys for human follow-up, so no business correction is implied.
difference_cents remains the owner-provided value and is null in this slice because PH-354 precheck does not recompute differences; no conservation assertion is made.

No canonical insights.reconciliation_* events are emitted in this slice; ReconciliationRefresh org+request_token receipts are the internal idempotency/history evidence. This is disclosed as a first-slice limitation.

Project workbench cash_net_cents is always null+missing because cash facts have no project attribution; company cash is never mixed into a project view. Cost/ETC come from costing budget_etc_snapshot; contract value from approved contract net; revenue from project_revenue_summary; open items from settlement coverage.
pm reconciliation list shows no company-scope cases in this slice (explicit hidden/company-scope restriction); pm workbench is limited to the managed project.
List project filtering uses coverage_key containment, so company-scope cases do not match a project filter; this is intentional to avoid mixing scopes.
